values.note: Dakota County Parks: standard nonelectric sites $28 a night, standard electric (30 amp) $35, full hookup (30/50 amp) $45, pull-through full hookup sites 56-58 $47, plus tax. Standard sites hold one camper up to 24 ft. $8 non-refundable reservation fee per site; full payment at booking; cancellations more than 48 hours out refunded less the $8 fee. Six people per site at most.

fees.source: https://dakotacountymn.gov/parks/parks-trails/lebanon-hills/lebanon-hills-campground ('Prices do not include taxes unless otherwise noted', 'Non-refundable reservation fee per site per reservation: $8', 'Pull-through full hook up sites (water, sewer, electric 30/50 amp) - sites 56, 57 & 58: $47 per night', 'Full hook up sites (water, sewer, electric 30/50 amp): $45 per night', 'Standard electric (30 amp) sites: $35 per night', 'Standard nonelectric sites: $28 per night', 'Standard electric and nonelectric sites can hold one 24-foot camper and 1-2 tents'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Reserve online (Dakota County WebTrac); 2027 reservations open Tuesday, March 9 at 9 a.m. All campers need a reservation and check in at the campground office on arrival. Three-night minimum on Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends; 14 nights at most in any 30 days, no long-term rentals. Check-in after 2 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://dakotacountymn.gov/parks/parks-trails/lebanon-hills/lebanon-hills-campground ('Lebanon Hills Campground reservations will open on Tuesday, March 9 at 9 a.m. CST', 'Reservations must be made online', 'There is a two-night minimum stay on weekends, and a three-night minimum stay on Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends', 'There is a 14-day maximum camping limit in any 30-day period'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: West loop 1-58 full hookup (no tents), lengths per site from 11 to 48 ft (most 30-45 ft; sites 1, 4, 9, 20, 34, 36, 37 and 43 are under 23 ft); pull-throughs 56-58 (45 ft) are one-way. North loop 59-69 nonelectric and east loop 70-93 30-amp electric hold a camper up to 24 ft. RV plus towed vehicle must fit on the pad.

note: Dakota County regional park campground in the woods of Lebanon Hills Regional Park, Apple Valley, minutes from the Twin Cities. --Claude
summary: Dakota County page and map read: 93 sites (58 full hookup 30/50 amp, 11 nonelectric, 24 30-amp electric), $28-$47 plus tax, $8 reservation fee, WebTrac online (2027 opens March 9), 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night limit, per-site lengths up to 48 ft (standard sites 24 ft), laundry, store, showers, dump. Closed for the 2026 season (seasonal). Season dates not stated; stored approximate May-Oct left.
flags: Not waterfront kept: Gerhardt Lake lies north of the north loop (sites 59-69) ~100 m away through woods; nothing on the water.
Fit: the 30-amp electric and nonelectric loops take campers up to 24 ft; the full-hookup loop posts per-site lengths (eight sites under 23 ft). Plenty fit a 23-ft rig.
